title: Credit Carried onto the First Direct Bill Invoice after a Move — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Rule.** On the **Installment Payment Plans**, when an owner plan is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan at the named insured's request, a credit the plan holds is carried onto the first invoice after the move as follows. The credit is the negative standing balance at the move: the amount by which the account balance, together with the switch down payment the move took, falls short of the premium left on the old schedule plus the endorsement premium left to bill. The respread installment premium is the premium left on the old schedule less that switch down payment, divided by the installments left and rounded half up to the cent.

1. **A credit larger than the respread installment premium plus 9.00, with two or more installments left:** the first invoice carries an equal share of the credit — the credit divided by the installments left, rounded half up to the cent — and the rest stays for the later invoices.
2. **Such a credit with only one installment left:** the first invoice carries the credit up to that respread premium plus 9.00; any rest is refunded when the plan closes.
3. **Otherwise** — a smaller credit, an unpaid earlier amount, or nothing — the first invoice carries the standing balance, an unpaid earlier amount added and a credit subtracted.

**Hypothetical cases (respread installment premium 214.57)**

| Credit held | Installments left | Carried onto the first invoice |
|---|---|---|
| 600.00 | 3 | 200.00 credit (600.00 divided by 3); 400.00 stays |
| 223.57 | 3 | 223.57 credit (not larger than 214.57 plus 9.00: the standing balance) |
| 223.58 | 2 | 111.79 credit |
